{{Quote|Where is the spice?|The torture droid, to Trace Martez|<ref name="Dangerous Debt" />}}
An '''8D-series smelter droid''' served the [[Pyke Syndicate]] on [[Oba Diah]], operating as a [[Interrogation droid|torture droid]] within the [[prison]] of the [[Pyke Palace|High fortress of the Pyke Syndicate]]. The [[smelter droid]] was assigned to [[Torture|interrogate]] the [[Martez family|sisters]] [[Rafa Martez|Rafa]] and [[Trace Martez]] after they failed to deliver a shipment of [[spice]] from [[Kessel]]. However, when Trace Martez was brought to the [[droid]], she managed to escape and shoot down the [[Pyke]]s holding her, one of whom fell onto the torture droid.<ref name="Dangerous Debt" />
